name: Momiji
message: 「……Shingan no Kiwamete, initiate！」
Momiji―san’s eyes, as she faces me, glow with an eerie light―
Momiji-san has come to take me down for real. Of course, that’s exactly what I wanted. Otherwise, this wouldn’t be worth it.

name: Asahi
message: （Or perhaps, she isn’t serious at all……）
I shiver at the thought—but I shake that feeling away now.
If I can’t strike down the Momiji-san standing before me, I won’t be able to reach what lies beyond, regardless of whether there is anything there or not.
She rushes straight at me—so directly it seems almost defenseless—as I hold my guard.

name: Asahi
message: （I’ll see through it…… Momiji-san’s reads, all of them！）
The first strike. A feint toward my feet from a low stance. I had read that. I shift my body slightly to dodge, readying a counter-stance.
Then the second strike. A follow―up to the low section―

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaaah—！」

name: Asahi
message: （Wrong！ Mid-section！）
My read was wrong already. Mid-section. I somehow manage to block the attack aimed at my torso.

name: Asahi
message: （Then, with a counter―attack―！）
I push back, aiming a flash-strike at Momiji-san’s feet to follow up, but she dodges it with ease.

name: Asahi
message: （She’s reading me…… Just as I thought, everything……！）

name: Momiji
message: 「Gotcha！」
With no way to stop it, I take the counter-strike.
From there, the onslaught would never ease up—

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaaaaaaaa！」
I managed to block the first one. The second one too. But I couldn’t hold the third. By the fourth, she had left me completely defenseless.

name: Asahi
message: 「Guh, ugh……！」
And as I fall to my knees, the final blow approaches—

name: Asahi
message: （I can’t win……！！）

name: Asahi
message: 「Aaaaaaah！」
A powerful strike from her long blade cuts me down, and I can do nothing but scream at the impact.
I collapse, resting on my hands. My Barrier Jacket is completely exhausted.

name: Momiji
message: 「Match over, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I'm completely beaten.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haah... What am I supposed to do...」
On my way back to the classroom after changing. I can't help letting out sighs and words of defeat.

name: Asahi
message: （In the end, I didn't have a single good moment...）
In today's training, I couldn't even wear down half of Momiji-san's Barrier Jacket.
That's just how overwhelming the gap in our abilities is.
Thinking about that makes my steps grow heavier and heavier.

name: Asahi
message: （My reads didn't work at all... Momiji-san's reads are far above mine...）
No matter how much I predicted her movements, she always read right through those predictions.
No matter what I tried... even when I gave everything I'd cultivated under Iori-san's guidance, Momiji-san read it all.
It felt like facing a monster who could see through everything. No matter what I do, no matter where I strike, she's always one step ahead.
Nothing I've built up until now works at all, leaving me at a loss for what to do.

name: Asahi
message: （Every path is blocked... it seems.）
Worse than that, it feels as if even my future has been blocked off.

name: Asahi
message: （So that's a Suzakuin... Is that what a true genius is...）
Will I never be able to catch up to her in my entire life—

name: Asahi
message: （At this rate, Toujinegi... a dream within a dream...）
It's barely been a day, and my spirit is already on the verge of breaking.
Is there really a path to making my dream come true—?
